title: UAAP: Bicierro stars in Ateneo's four-goal rout of National U
summary: Jada Bicierro led the way in Ateneo de Manila University's 4-0 demolition of National University in the UAAP Season 89 women's football tournament on Wednesday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
